clue.text: Conservative member not happy making U-turn

clue.text: Train, or alternative to it?

explanation.definitionFit: To coach is to tutor or instruct; a coach is also a long-distance bus, which travellers pick instead of the railway.

clue.text: Guilty-seeming way to fall foul of the RSPCA?

clue.text: Preserve agreement to put in German marks
